name: l2_scn_0301_occupation_and_insurgency_v1
about: L2 scenario seed SCN-0301 (Occupation and Insurgency) overlaid on an Orion Station watch. The seed is a pressure field and initial-condition template: roles, pressure axes, and knobs shape the run; expected end states are observation categories, never required endings. Root fixture only; not canon.
